Hello, my name is Gabriela Shirley! 

I am a rising senior majoring in Computer Science with a minor in Design at the [University of California, San Diego](https://ucsd.edu/), will be graduating in June 2021! Born and raised in Jakarta, Indonesia since January 13, 1999. (◔ᴥ◔)

I am driven to expand my horizons in different types of fields and hope to use my accumulated knowledge to make an impact on my community and even the world. Although I am focusing on Computer Science, specifically Web/Software Engineer, I also plan on studying design and human cognition in order to combine both my technical and personal skills and create new applications that will ultimately help others.

I am passionate about being a woman agent of change with my work in the tech field and willing to get hands-on with any websites, applications, or anything in between.

Please feel free to reach me out for any inquiries! 🤗

*I am currently looking for full-time job opportunities after my June 2021 graduation. *
